title: Compatibility complexes for the conformal-to-Einstein operator
summary: The conformal-to-Einstein operator is a conformally invariant linear overdetermined differential operator whose non-vanishing solutions correspond to Einstein metrics within a conformal class. We construct compatibility complexes for this operator under natural genericity assumptions on the Weyl curvature in dimension $n\ge 4$, which implies at most one independent solution. An analogous result for the projective-to-Ricci-flat operator is obtained as well.
